_comment: One unit of competency. It exists as a file because the catalogue lists a unit — and Moodle gets a grade item for it — only once this file ships. The lessons below were READ OFF the built pages' data-criteria, not asserted here, so this cannot drift from what is actually taught.
title: Identify and group hand tools
taughtBy: Marking Out and Cutting a Halving Joint

criteria.text: Group hand tools by what they do: measuring and marking, cutting, planing, boring, striking, holding.
Name the parts of a tenon saw, a smoothing plane, a firmer chisel, a try square and a marking gauge.
Select the right saw for a cut: rip saw along the grain, tenon saw for small accurate cuts and tenons, dovetail saw for fine work, frame saw for straight and curved cuts.
criteria.evidence: Tool selection observed at the bench.

criteria.text: Choose a mallet rather than a claw hammer when striking a chisel or a wooden surface, and say why.
